soundness_flags.label: ass:target-separable and ass:dense-enumeration
soundness_flags.one_line: The fixed countable dense enumeration asserted by ass:dense-enumeration already implies separability of every H_k in L2(P_X), so ass:target-separable is redundant and should be removed or the enumeration condition weakened.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: conj:validated-misspecified-trae / ass:pseudotrue-attainment
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Existence of the minimum-norm least-squares pseudo-true projection is assumed for the misspecified conditional-moment branch.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The oracle inequality is conditional on attained h^dagger and is causally interpretable as h_0 only under the additional valid-IV and completeness branch.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: prop:zero-defect-calibration / ass:grid-coverage
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The exact-branch saturated calibration assumes that the finite grid reaches the continuous oracle scale and, for its final delta-only simplification, that holdout scale is no larger than training scale.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The exact-branch rate reduction is conditional on these displayed grid and scale premises, rather than an unconditional tightening of Tan--Syrgkanis.

source_verification_receipts.locator: §3.2, Assumptions 3.9--3.10, Proposition 3.12, Theorem 3.13, and Appendix B
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper analyzes discrepancy-principle selection for TRAE under its witness/richness and source conditions, proves termination, and gives adaptive strong and weak guarantees; it is not a split-validation oracle inequality over misspecified target--witness pairs.

Theorem 12 treats misspecified RDIV through target-class and learned conditional-density/operator errors; Algorithm 2 and Theorem 13 use a separate validation set and regularized explicit-operator loss for model selection.
The proceedings paper studies regularized minimax conditional-moment estimation with bounded symmetric/star-convex test classes, witness richness, and localized-Rademacher critical radii.
The paper defines the NPIV conditional moment T h=r_0, records Jensen boundedness of T, and characterizes the least-norm solution when an exact solution exists.

The paper defines fixed-tuning Tikhonov regularized adversarial population and empirical criteria under an exact inverse equation and gives source-condition bias control for iterated Tikhonov regularization.
